title: 第25章 神卷隐秘第26章 凡蜕
lines: 玄之又玄，众妙之门。
修行的门户朝许平秋敞开了大门，世间的一切比起此中玄妙都显得无足轻重。
许平秋身心都沉浸在其中，陷入了入定，只能觉察有一点火光自天脉浮起，寻着地脉而通，紧接着便是九十九道凡脉。
火光逐渐流动，一道道灵脉被它点亮，像是贯连的火龙，最终首尾相连，百脉贯通。
一种莫名的愉悦感传来，许平秋感觉自己似乎打通了什么界限，但又朦胧的说不上来，但总归是好事。
轻呼了一口气后，许平秋睁开了眼，他感觉自己似乎轻灵了不少，五脏六腑似如山泉涤荡而过，去浊留清。
此时，天色已近黄昏。暮色斜阳，自窗棂洒落，将整间屋子，都笼罩上了一层温暖的橘色。
许平秋总算明白为什么修行者能够不知疲倦，一闭关就不知年岁了，此中滋味当真难与外人道也。
“怎么样怎么样？”
乐临清寸步未离，一直守候在旁，见许平秋睁眼，立刻凑近了些，关切的问道。
少女眼眸倒映起一缕暮色，潋滟着柔光，一种清香没有丝毫避忌，漫了过来。
许平秋不由伸手抚向她的脸颊，回道：“感觉很好，应该是入门了。”
“那…那就好！”
乐临清像是没有在意许平秋亲昵的举止，但眼神闪躲间，耳垂不自然的攀起了些许薄红，像是被夕阳染红。
“我，我帮你看看吧！”
乐临清将画卷放到一旁，伸手搭在了许平秋另一只手上。
“好。”许平秋点了点头，紧接着一道温润同源的灵力便顺着手腕进入灵脉中流转。
现在被乐临清进入体内倒没有之前那么刺激，似乎是因为灵脉中有着自己的灵力作为缓和，这令许平秋说不清是好是坏。
乐临清顺着灵脉游走了一圈，这路径令许平秋有些陌生，但又有些熟悉。
这似乎是之前金乌展现出九十九道光点时，灵脉流转的变化，也就是说这是凡脉的修行法，不是地脉和天脉的。
因为在超过九十九道灵脉后，每多一道灵脉，这修行运转的路径就大为不同，但有一点可以肯定，运转的始终都是从天脉或地脉开始。
“你灵脉运转的路径是这样的吗？”
许平秋询问道，他感觉自己应该不会那么凑巧，窥见了画卷中的隐秘吧？
但乐临清却还真点了点头，有些疑惑的反问道：“你不是吗？”
“不是，在这幅画卷的金乌只有九十九道灵脉，但是金乌的身后还残留着一道身影，祂的身侧有剩下的两道，显化为了日月。”
许平秋将自己在金乌神卷中看到的画面说出，但换来了乐临清的一脸茫然。
她伸手拿起金乌神卷，闭起了眼眸，但很快她再度睁开，摇了摇头，说：“除了金乌外，我什么都没看到。”
许平秋有些奇怪的将画卷拿起，闭目再度引动画卷的神异，来到了那处大日金乌前，但他想要再度窥探那道身影时，却发现怎么都找不到了。
“奇怪。”
许平秋有种见了鬼的感觉，他有些烦这种神神叨叨的玩意，因为他感觉这种破事到最后一般都不会是好事。
但眼下，除了吐槽一句也别无他法，许平秋握紧住乐临清手，说道：“你感受一下我的运转。”
许平秋闭目，心中观想起刚刚的画面，那种修行法像是烙印在了他的脑中，他将天脉给屏蔽，仅留下地脉的运转，供乐临清参考。
content_en:
Mysterious and mysterious, the door to all mysteries.
The door of spiritual practice opened to Xu Pingqiu, and everything in the world seemed insignificant compared to the mystery within it.
Xu Pingqiu was immersed in it both physically and mentally, and fell into trance. He could only detect a little fire rising from the heavenly veins, searching for the earth veins, followed by ninety-nine mortal veins.
The fire light gradually flows, and the spiritual veins are lit up by it, like a connected fire dragon, and finally connected end to end, with hundreds of veins connected.
An inexplicable sense of joy came over, and Xu Pingqiu felt as if he had broken through some boundaries, but it was too vague to describe, but it was always a good thing.
After taking a breath, Xu Pingqiu opened his eyes. He felt that he seemed to be much lighter, and his internal organs seemed to be washed away by a mountain spring, removing the turbidity and leaving the pure.
At this time, it was almost dusk. The twilight sun shone through the window lattice, covering the entire room with a layer of warm orange.
Xu Pingqiu finally understood why practitioners can be tireless and lose track of their age once they are in seclusion. This feeling is really difficult to explain to outsiders.
"How about it?"
Le Linqing didn't leave even an inch, waiting by the side. Seeing Xu Pingqiu open his eyes, he immediately came closer and asked with concern.
The girl's eyes reflected a ray of dusk, shimmering with soft light, and a fragrance spread over her without any hesitation.
Xu Pingqiu couldn't help but stretched out his hand to caress her cheek and replied: "It feels good, I think I'm getting started."
"That...that's good!"
Le Linqing didn't seem to pay attention to Xu Pingqiu's intimate behavior, but as his eyes evaded, his earlobes turned a little red unnaturally, as if they were dyed red by the sunset.
"I, let me help you take a look!"
Le Linqing put the scroll aside and put his hand on Xu Pingqiu's other hand.
"Okay." Xu Pingqiu nodded, and then a warm and homogenous spiritual power flowed down his wrist into his spiritual veins.
Having Le Linqing enter his body now is not as exciting as before. It seems to be because there is his own spiritual power in the spiritual veins as a buffer. Xu Pingqiu can't tell whether it is good or bad.
Le Linqing walked around along the spiritual veins. This path was a little strange to Xu Pingqiu, but also a little familiar.
This seems to be the change in the flow of spiritual veins when the Golden Crow showed ninety-nine points of light. In other words, this is the practice method of mortal veins, not earth veins and heaven veins.
Because after more than ninety-nine spiritual veins, each additional spiritual vein will lead to a very different path for the practice, but one thing is certain, the operation always starts from the heavenly veins or the earthly veins.
"Is this the way your spiritual veins circulate?"
Xu Pingqiu asked, he felt that he couldn't have glimpsed the secret in the painting by chance, right?
But Le Linqing actually nodded and asked with some confusion: "Aren't you?"
"No, the Golden Crow in this scroll only has ninety-nine spiritual veins, but there is still a figure behind the Golden Crow, and there are two remaining veins on his side, manifesting into the sun and the moon."
Xu Pingqiu told the scene he saw in the Golden Crow Divine Scroll, but received a confused look from Le Linqing.
She reached out to pick up the Golden Crow Scroll and closed her eyes, but soon she opened them again, shook her head and said, "I didn't see anything except the Golden Crow."
Xu Pingqiu picked up the scroll with some strangeness, closed his eyes and once again evoked the magic of the scroll, and came to the Great Sun and Golden Crow, but when he wanted to spy on the figure again, he found that he could not find it.
"Strange."
Xu Pingqiu felt like he had seen a ghost. He was a little annoyed by such nonsense, because he felt that such nonsense would usually not be a good thing in the end.
But at the moment, having no choice but to complain, Xu Pingqiu held Le Linqing's hand tightly and said, "Feel my operation."
Xu Pingqiu closed his eyes and imagined the scene just now. The practice method seemed to be imprinted in his mind. He blocked the heavenly veins, leaving only the movement of the earthly veins for Le Linqing's reference.
